purpose: Land on the Devin Review surface — your open PRs organized by category. Entry point for code review workflow.
Merge a PR directly from Devin Review without leaving the page.

examples.invocation: Open PR in Devin Review > Merge button

command: [UI] Devin Review > PR detail > Toggle auto-merge
purpose: Toggle GitHub auto-merge on/off from inside Devin Review.

command: [UI] Devin Review > chat > 'Make this change' > Apply as commit
purpose: Ask the chat agent for code edits, review the suggestions, and apply as a commit to the PR branch from inside Devin Review.

examples.invocation: Highlight a function in the diff > 'Apply prop drilling fix' > review > Apply
examples.scenario: In-review code change without leaving the surface

command: [UI] Settings > Devin's Settings > Knowledge > Add knowledge
purpose: Add product-Knowledge-feature entries (architecture docs, conventions, team workflows) used by Devin across sessions in a repo.

examples.invocation: Settings > Devin's Settings > Knowledge > 'Add knowledge: 'Always run pnpm typecheck before committing''

purpose: Create a reusable instruction set with optional macro identifier. Macros (e.g., `!plan`, `!review`) become triggers in Slack/Teams/Jira/Linear.

examples.invocation: Settings > Playbooks > Create > name='Plan only', macro='!plan', instructions='Read the issue, propose a plan, do not edit'

purpose: Create a recurring or one-time scheduled session.

examples.invocation: Settings > Schedules > Create > prompt='Run weekly dependency upgrade', cron='0 9 * * 1', tz='America/New_York'

purpose: Add a secret. Referenced as $NAME in blueprints and sessions. Org-scoped by default; can also be created at enterprise tier.
View per-session ACU usage, timeline, and AI-generated summary.

examples.invocation: Open a completed session > Insights tab

purpose: Install Devin for Terminal (the local CLI agent). Cross-references the devbox concept of the same name.
Browse the MCP marketplace to enable third-party tool integrations. 1-click for many; credentials/headers for others.

examples.invocation: Settings > MCP Marketplace > Datadog > Enable + provide DD-API-KEY
